model_meta.notice: Synthetic engineering hypotheses; not real fish psychology or biological validation.
model_meta.fit: First 7 days per fish (hours 0-167); last 3 days chronological holdout (hours 168-239).
model_meta.feature_source: Realized action and 3D position over trailing 60 minutes; hour 0 is instantaneous. No latent state, event, or intake feature.
model_meta.simulation: Independent seeded fish, 1-minute latent/action/position updates; scheduled daily food opportunities and disturbances; H rises 0.00075/min and drops 0.35 only on simulated intake; S decays 0.005*S/min and gains 0.72 per disturbance; E follows a new noisy diurnal mean-reverting target (not the old fixed-E short-session rule).
model_meta.hmm: Supervised label-anchored Gaussian HMM; per-fish forward filtering only, no smoothing or future observations.
model_meta.probabilities: P(synthetic high state >= 0.5), not continuous state regression; trained on this new hourly mechanism, not old 4-second windows.
